card.name: Enzyme digit and inhibition verbs in interactions
card.fires_on: The digit 2 inside CYP enzyme names such as CYP2D6 and CYP2C9, and verbs like blocks, inhibits or inhibits right after a drug name in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: CYP enzyme digit
modes.description: The number 2 right after CYP or P450 in enzyme names.
modes.example: Fluoxetine can increase the level of pimozide through inhibition of CYP<<2>>D6.

modes.label: Inhibiting verb after drug
modes.description: A verb such as blocks, inhibit or inhibits that follows a drug name and states its action.
